name: Test of Lore
summary: In Thousand Needles, Dorn Plainstalker sends Horde champions north to face a trial of the world's history. Braug Dimspirit waits in Stonetalon Mountains to test what they know of Azeroth and its shared suffering.

sections.title: From Faith to Lore
sections.body: At the Weathered Nook, Dorn Plainstalker tests initiates in faith, endurance, and combat. Yet strength and faith alone do not make a true Horde champion. Dorn knows the bounds of what he can teach, so he sends those who have proved themselves to Stonetalon Mountains. There, an elder shaman will test their minds and knowledge of the world.

sections.title: The Road to Stonetalon
sections.body: The road runs north over the Barrens' dry scrub and into the crags of Stonetalon. High in the mountains, near the entrance to Talondeep Path, Braug Dimspirit keeps his hermitage. The cavern cuts through the rock toward Ashenvale. From there, Braug looks upon a frontier at war: goblin logging ventures despoil the forests, while hostile night elves fiercely defend their ancestral borders.

sections.title: A Broader Perspective
sections.body: Braug Dimspirit asks champions to look beyond factional pride. He speaks of Azeroth's tragic state and the blame laid on orcs and Forsaken for war and corruption. Yet almost every civilization shares responsibility for the land's plight. Goblins tear down ancient timber, and night elves distrust the younger races. To pass the trial, a champion must see beyond these enmities and understand the history of a wounded world.

faq.q: What is the Test of Lore?
faq.answer: The Test of Lore is one trial in a rite of passage shaped by tauren elders. Initiates show physical might and faith, along with knowledge of history and Azeroth's shared past.

faq.q: Where can I find Braug Dimspirit?
faq.answer: Braug Dimspirit lives high in the Stonetalon Mountains, near Windshear Crag and the entrance to Talondeep Path. The cave links Stonetalon to Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why does Dorn Plainstalker send you away?
faq.answer: Dorn Plainstalker oversees the trials of faith, endurance, and strength in Thousand Needles. The world's lore lies beyond what he can teach, so he sends worthy initiates to Braug, a shaman wise enough to test their minds.

faq.q: What threats should travelers look out for on the way?
faq.answer: Dorn warns that night elves prowl the borderlands near Ashenvale and Stonetalon, where they see the Horde as an intruder. Volatile goblin logging operations also fill the area around Windshear Crag.

faq.q: What is Braug Dimspirit's view of the world's conflicts?
faq.answer: Braug Dimspirit believes all mortal races share blame for the world's suffering. Orcs and Forsaken often bear blame from their rivals, while goblin greed and night elven arrogance have also harmed Kalimdor and Lordaeron.
Talondeep Path is a mountain tunnel linking Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains with the ancient woodland borders of southern Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a tauren, you face trials that prize spiritual harmony and knowledge of history above raw bloodlust.
As a shaman, you can read the land's suffering in reckless deeds, from goblin exploitation to ancient elven isolation.
As a member of the Horde, you must reckon with your allies' reputations. Orcs and Forsaken share responsibility with others for the land's troubles.
